canonical_question: Do you encrypt data at rest?
answer: All data at rest is encrypted using AES-256. Encryption is enforced at the storage layer and verified continuously through Drata.

canonical_question: Do you encrypt data in transit?
answer: All data in transit is encrypted using TLS 1.2 or higher. Plain HTTP connections are rejected.

canonical_question: Do you have a SOC 2 Type II report?
answer: Yes. Our SOC 2 Type II report is available under NDA. Please contact your account executive.

canonical_question: Are you ISO 27001 certified?
answer: Yes. We hold ISO 27001 certification. Our certificate is available upon request.

canonical_question: Do you conduct background checks on employees?
answer: All employees undergo background verification as part of the hiring process prior to system access.

canonical_question: Do you have a vulnerability management program?
answer: Yes. We conduct quarterly vulnerability scans and monthly penetration tests on production systems. Critical findings are remediated within 72 hours.

canonical_question: How do you manage access to production systems?
answer: Production access follows least-privilege principles and requires MFA. Access is reviewed quarterly and revoked immediately upon departure.

canonical_question: Do you have a data breach notification process?
answer: Yes. We notify affected customers within 72 hours of confirming a breach in compliance with GDPR Article 33.

canonical_question: Where is customer data stored?
answer: Customer data is stored in EU-based data centers. Data residency options are available for enterprise customers.

canonical_question: Do you have a business continuity plan?
answer: Yes. Our BCP is tested annually. Recovery Time Objective is 4 hours. Recovery Point Objective is 1 hour.

canonical_question: Do you use subprocessors?
answer: Yes. A current list of subprocessors is maintained on our Trust page and customers are notified 30 days before any changes.

canonical_question: How do you handle GDPR data subject requests?
answer: We process data subject requests within 30 days. A dedicated privacy portal allows customers to submit access deletion and portability requests.

canonical_question: Do you have multi-factor authentication?
answer: Yes. MFA is mandatory for all employees accessing production systems and administrative interfaces.

canonical_question: What is your patch management process?
answer: Critical patches are applied within 72 hours of release. All systems are patched monthly. Patch compliance is tracked in Drata.

canonical_question: Do you log and monitor access to customer data?
answer: Yes. All access to customer data is logged. Logs are retained for 12 months and reviewed by the security team.

canonical_question: Do you have cyber insurance?
answer: Yes. We maintain cyber liability insurance. Coverage details are available under NDA.

canonical_question: How do you handle security incidents?
answer: Our incident response plan follows NIST SP 800-61. All incidents are logged tracked and reviewed post-incident.

canonical_question: Do you conduct security awareness training?
answer: Yes. All employees complete annual security awareness training. Completion is tracked and reported in Drata.

canonical_question: Do you have a GDPR Data Processing Agreement available?
answer: Yes. Our DPA is available for signature upon request. It covers all processing activities under GDPR Article 28.

canonical_question: What frameworks do you comply with?
answer: We currently maintain compliance with ISO 27001 SOC 2 Type II HiTrust and GDPR. Our compliance posture is monitored continuously in Drata.
